definitions.explanation: An outdoor extension of a building, typically with a roof, often used for drying laundry, keeping plants, or relaxing.

examples.japanese: ベランダで{洗濯物|せんたくもの}を{干|ほ}す。
examples.english: I hang the laundry to dry on the balcony.

examples.japanese: ベランダに{花|はな}を{飾|かざ}っている。
examples.english: I have flowers displayed on the balcony.

examples.japanese: ベランダから{夜景|やけい}が{見|み}える。
examples.english: You can see the night view from the balcony.

notes:
ベランダ is a loanword from Portuguese/English "veranda," referring to a covered outdoor extension of a building, typically an apartment balcony.

USAGE:
In Japanese apartments, ベランダ is typically used for:
- {洗濯物|せんたくもの}を{干|ほ}す: hanging laundry to dry
- {布団|ふとん}を{干|ほ}す: airing futons
- {植物|しょくぶつ}を{置|お}く: keeping plants

SIMILAR WORDS:
- バルコニー: balcony (often used interchangeably, but technically has no roof)
- テラス: terrace (ground level)
- {縁側|えんがわ}: Japanese-style veranda (traditional wooden walkway along the edge of a house)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ベランダに{出|で}る: to go out onto the veranda
- ベランダで{洗濯物|せんたくもの}を{干|ほ}す: to hang laundry on the veranda
